title: Mindfulness is here
hook: don't envy, don't hate, don't turn your backs; mindfulness is here, he said, pointing to his chest three times
tomorrow: you help a friend through a bad week. who's helping you?

segments.voice: Yesterday, the ladder: hand, tongue, and at least with the heart. And a week of lines before it. Guard the tongue. Silence is mercy too. Want less, be loved. No harm. Prove it first. Today, where all of them start.
screen: `GUARD THE TONGUE · SILENCE IS MERCY TOO · WANT LESS` → `NO HARM · PROVE IT FIRST · AT LEAST WITH THE HEART` → `WHERE THEY ALL START.`

segments.voice: Everyone keeps a version of themselves for the camera: the clean desk, the good angle, the caption that sounds kind. Yesterday's question: he pointed at his chest three times; at what? In hadith thirty-five, from Sahih Muslim, the Prophet, peace be upon him, lists what tears people apart. Don't envy each other. Don't hate each other. Don't turn your backs on each other. Be servants of Allah, brothers. Then he says: taqwa is here, and points to his chest. Three times.
screen: `A VERSION FOR THE CAMERA.` → `DON'T ENVY, DON'T HATE.` → `HE POINTS TO HIS CHEST.`

segments.voice: Taqwa is hard to put in one English word: mindfulness of Allah, God-consciousness, a guard kept on yourself. Look at where he puts it. Everything on his list happens between people, out in the open: envy, hatred, turned backs, cheating on a sale. And the source of all of it, he says, is in a place no camera reaches. Then, right after pointing, a hard line: it's evil enough for a person to look down on his brother. One wording in the same collection makes the point sharper: Allah doesn't look at your bodies or your faces, but at your hearts. That's the line to tell a friend tonight. Now hold up the week. Guard the tongue. Leave the silences alone. Want less. Start no harm. Prove it first. At least with the heart. Six lines, and every one of them is what taqwa in the chest looks like from the outside.
screen: `TAQWA: A GUARD KEPT ON YOURSELF.` · `THE LIST IS OUT IN THE OPEN.` · `THE SOURCE IS IN THE CHEST.` · `SIX LINES, ONE PLACE.` · then, large: `TAQWA IS HERE.`

segments.voice: Rest your right hand flat on your chest. Three times, slowly, press lightly, once for each time he pointed. Then leave the hand there for the sit and feel it rise and fall, no camera, no caption, just the place the hadith points to.
screen: `A HAND ON THE CHEST.` · `THREE TIMES, SLOWLY.`

segments.voice: Mindfulness is here: the Prophet's words with his hand on his chest. Taqwa lives inside, and shows up in how people treat each other.
Your line: taqwa is here, where no camera reaches, and it shows in how you treat people. A full week, done.

screen: `DAY 1463 COUNTS.` → `HADITH 35 OF 42 · YEAR FIVE, 37 OF 365.` → `TOMORROW: YOU HELP A FRIEND THROUGH A BAD WEEK. WHO'S HELPING YOU?`
